rows.quote: Ranged attacks have a %proc_chance%%% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to %count% nearby enemies
rows.reason_zh: 一次远程攻击仍有概率以额外弹道伤害附近多个敌人，新增说明限定幻象攻击不能触发。

rows.quote: Attacks poison enemies, dealing %poison_damage_per_second%%% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second
rows.reason_zh: 普通攻击仍能使敌人中毒并按其最大生命值造成持续魔法伤害。

rows.quote: If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage on that attack.
rows.reason_zh: 以攻击结束隐身时，该次攻击仍附带额外物理伤害。

rows.quote: windwalk_movement_speed: 20→16
rows.reason_zh: 隐身期间的移速加成从20%降至16%，仍能使自身加速。

rows.quote: Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.
rows.reason_zh: 主动效果仍使使用者隐身，攻击或施法可提前结束隐身。

rows.quote: While Shadow Walk is active, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.
rows.reason_zh: 疾风步期间仍可穿过单位，符合相位移动的定义。

rows.quote: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放仍能伤害陨石下方的多个敌人，各等级的灼烧伤害也都大于零。

rows.quote: Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort
rows.reason_zh: 向前滚动的是陨石，命中敌人的效果只有伤害和灼烧，原先排除位移他人的判断成立。

rows.quote: Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage.
rows.reason_zh: 后续伤害反复触发同一敌人身上的冻结和额外伤害，说明未赋予多目标伤害。

rows.quote: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.
rows.reason_zh: 说明明确将冻结称为眩晕，并保留了按减免后伤害判断的触发门槛。

rows.quote: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍以一个敌人为施放目标，并在该目标身上施加冻结效果。

rows.quote: dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with
rows.reason_zh: 一次声波仍能对沿途碰到的多个敌方单位造成伤害。

rows.quote: then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex
rows.reason_zh: 声波仍在击退后缴械敌人，持续时间取决于雷元素等级。

rows.quote: knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas
rows.reason_zh: 基础声波仍能击退命中的敌方单位。

new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42更改了可驱散性字段，并明确击退部分不可驱散。

rows.quote: The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex . Deals damage for each point of mana drained.
rows.reason_zh: 一次爆炸仍能削减范围内多个敌人的法力，并按削减量造成伤害。

rows.quote: builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 这里的蓄能指目标地点延迟爆炸的过程，说明没有每次施放消耗一点的充能次数。

rows.quote: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
rows.reason_zh: 说明仅指出已被吹起的单位不受脉冲影响，脉冲本身没有施加吹风或放逐的效果。

rows.quote: pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶升级仍能将敌方单位拉向脉冲中心。

rows.quote: The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex .
rows.reason_zh: 基础爆炸仍按雷元素等级削减目标法力。

rows.quote: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second.
rows.reason_zh: 烧蓝已由基础技能提供，魔晶仅提高每点烧蓝造成的伤害并增加牵引，因此排除魔晶单独提供烧蓝的判断成立。

rows.quote: If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains %self_mana_restore_pct%%% of the mana drained.
rows.reason_zh: 削减敌方英雄的法力时，祈求者仍按削减量的一定比例回蓝。

rows.quote: The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes.
rows.reason_zh: 熔炉精灵的攻击仍能降低敌方英雄的护甲。

rows.quote: The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes.
rows.reason_zh: 减甲随熔炉精灵的普通攻击施加，符合攻击特效的定义。

rows.quote: attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas . The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort .
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍召唤熔炉精灵，且明确说明精灵的生命值取决于冰元素等级。

rows.quote: Ghost Walk now also applies %ice_wall_damage_multiplier%x the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶仍对范围内的敌方英雄造成寒冰之墙的每秒伤害，7.42将魔晶伤害倍率设为1.25。

rows.quote: The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas
rows.reason_zh: 减速持续作用于祈求者附近的敌人，仍是以祈求者为中心的敌方减速光环。

rows.quote: rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍为祈求者提供生命恢复。

rows.quote: rendering his body invisible
rows.reason_zh: 幽灵漫步仍使祈求者自身隐身。

rows.quote: gaining health and mana regen
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍为祈求者提供法力恢复。

rows.quote: slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍降低附近敌人的移动速度，减速幅度取决于冰元素等级。

rows.quote: The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort .
rows.reason_zh: 冰墙仍可每秒对其附近的多个敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas .
rows.reason_zh: 冰墙仍在施放时的前方位置持续存在，使附近敌人持续受到减速和伤害。

rows.quote: Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on Quas .
rows.reason_zh: A杖升级仍会缠绕在区域内停留超过指定时间的敌方英雄。

rows.quote: greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas
rows.reason_zh: 基础冰墙仍能降低附近敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
rows.reason_zh: 基础伤害数值虽有调整，命中的多个敌人仍会均摊伤害。

rows.quote: Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.
rows.reason_zh: A杖触发的大灾变仍在每个敌方英雄附近产生阳炎冲击，一次施放可伤害多个敌人。

rows.quote: Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
rows.reason_zh: 该效果允许祈求者在经验范围外取得击杀经验，说明没有额外发放经验或金钱。

rows.quote: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
rows.reason_zh: 冲击落下前仍会提供目标区域的视野。

rows.quote: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶升级仍在阳炎冲击伤害敌方英雄时，于该处召唤当前等级的熔炉精灵。

rows.quote: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
rows.reason_zh: 一次飓风仍能卷起路径上的多个敌人，并在他们落地时造成伤害。

rows.quote: dealing damage based on Wex in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds
rows.reason_zh: A杖生成的小旋风仍按固定间隔在指定半径内造成范围伤害。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍明确施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air
rows.reason_zh: 基础飓风仍会将路径上的敌人卷至空中，使其暂时无法行动。

rows.quote: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas , dealing damage based on Wex in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: A杖仍沿路径留下持续存在的小旋风，在各自的作用半径内周期性造成伤害。

rows.quote: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
rows.reason_zh: 被飓风卷起的单位在空中仍处于无敌状态。

rows.quote: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
rows.reason_zh: 每次普攻仍由两个头各发动一次攻击，单次攻击的伤害折减从51%调为50%。

rows.quote: attack_damage_reduction: 51→50
rows.reason_zh: 材料只给出攻击伤害折减的变化，缺少判定能否被破坏所需的IsBreakable字段值。

rows.quote: The second attack ignores Damage Block.
rows.reason_zh: 第二次攻击能无视伤害格挡，技能本身没有赋予承伤方护盾或减伤。

rows.quote: deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
rows.reason_zh: 调整后各等级伤害仍大于零，火焰仍可同时伤害区域内多个敌人。

rows.quote: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍在地面留下持续燃烧的火带，对其中的敌人逐秒造成伤害。

rows.quote: Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.
rows.reason_zh: A杖升级仍沿火带两侧生成冰墙，敌人穿越这些区域时会受到减速。

rows.quote: slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%
rows.reason_zh: A杖冰墙仍会降低试图穿越它的敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.
rows.reason_zh: 标枪仍有概率使普通攻击附带额外魔法伤害。

rows.quote: deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage
rows.reason_zh: 触发时直接造成额外魔法伤害，说明没有降低目标魔抗或增加其后续受到的魔法伤害。

rows.quote: a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion
rows.reason_zh: 每次攻击仍有概率触发无视闪避。

rows.quote: dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units
rows.reason_zh: 基础剑刃风暴仍周期性伤害主宰周围的多个敌方单位。

rows.quote: Applies a basic dispel at the start and end of the spin. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 7.41f结束时的强驱散已改为开始和结束时各施加一次弱驱散。

rows.quote: rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance
rows.reason_zh: 旋转期间主宰仍获得减益免疫。

new_mechanisms.quote: Applies a basic dispel at the start and end of the spin.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42的基础技能在旋转开始和结束时都会施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.
rows.reason_zh: 治疗以可移动的守卫为中心，持续作用于守卫附近的所有友方单位。

rows.quote: heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health
rows.reason_zh: 守卫仍按附近友方单位各自的最大生命值提供治疗。

rows.quote: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.
rows.reason_zh: 基础说明确认会召出守卫，但没有交代守卫按生命值还是受攻击次数判定死亡，无法核实原排除判断。

rows.quote: Juggernaut continues to jump slash nearby random enemies (including the previously slashed enemy)
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放仍能连续跳斩附近不同的敌人，符合多目标伤害的定义。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 7.42说明仍明确标注弱驱散。

rows.quote: Juggernaut is invulnerable and has increased attack speed during Omnislash.
rows.reason_zh: 主宰在无敌斩持续期间仍处于无敌状态。

rows.quote: Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy unit and then slashes it.
rows.reason_zh: 说明确认可以跳斩敌方单位，但材料没有给出判定能否无视减益免疫所需的immunity字段值。

rows.quote: Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy unit and then slashes it.
rows.reason_zh: 施放无敌斩仍会使主宰主动跃向目标，改变自身位置。

rows.quote: Juggernaut continues to jump slash nearby random enemies (including the previously slashed enemy)
rows.reason_zh: 说明确认可以在敌人间跳斩，但未说明移动能否无视悬崖、树木等地形阻挡。

rows.quote: Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy unit and then slashes it.
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍选择一个敌方单位作为首次跳斩目标。

rows.quote: Multiple instances of this item do not stack.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只交代同一物品不能叠加，所给字段也未列出任何回蓝数值，无法独立确认回蓝效果。

rows.quote: spell_amp: 10→6
rows.reason_zh: 法术放大从10降至6，仍有正值加成。

rows.quote: mana_regen_multiplier: 30→25
rows.reason_zh: 法力恢复倍率加成从30降至25，仍能提高自身回蓝。
7.42没有提供装备说明，变化字段也未列出减速抗性，无法独立确认该属性。

rows.quote: spell_amp: 12→10
rows.reason_zh: 法术放大从12降至10，仍能提高技能伤害。

rows.quote: Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.
rows.reason_zh: 释放后的冲击波仍沿路径造成伤害，一次施放可伤及路径上的多个敌人。

rows.quote: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍明确要求持续引导，引导时间决定冲击波的威力。

rows.quote: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.
rows.reason_zh: 引导期间提供的视野仍会逐渐扩大，释放后的冲击波也会提供路径视野。
